Design review · 11 October 2026 · preview on sample data

Crater, in the bright atelier

The storefront now carries the Elise template's editorial structure at the Nuda template's brightness. This page shows what the customer asked for, what was measured in both references, the decisions, and the screens before and after.

What she said

“Elise is ok, but Nuda is brighter. I like the brightness of Nuda.”

Kept from Elise

  • Soft old-style serif with one italic word per heading
  • A small sentence-case label above every section heading
  • Numbered 01–04 tiles and arrow-led links
  • A wider feature card at the front of the collection
  • Warm cream surfaces, 10px corners, generous whitespace

Taken from Nuda

  • A near-white page instead of cream
  • No dark bands anywhere: announcement bar, story and footer are light
  • One fresh leaf-green, reserved for buttons and links
  • Pale tints (sage, peach) for the two editorial bands
  • Pill filters, flat image tiles, no card shadows

Every text pairing was measured: body text 16.5:1, secondary text 7.2:1, white on green buttons 6.5:1, bronze accent word 5.1:1. The two reference templates were measured from their live pages; nothing was copied from them.

Kept honest

Three questions for the customer
  1. One deep-green band for weight, or fully light? Built fully light, as her words suggest.
  2. Did she buy the Elise template or its fonts? Built with original copy and open-licence fonts; only the structure and feel are echoed.
  3. Does she have real reviews, a story, sourcing facts, policies or photography? Built with those sections omitted or marked pending until she does.
